title: Mochizuki Honami — A Piece Of Kindness〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: After school the next day
Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's start with the usual once we're all set up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sounds good! Ichi, can you help me carry the keyboard over?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, be right there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness Ichika seems better today. She really had me worried after pulling that all-nighter...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm sure she's fine now since we had a pleasant chat this morning at school, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're carrying over the drum kit, right, Honami? Want some help?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Huh? That sounded a bit funny...
We played it right, but it felt off for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, we didn't make any mistakes.
I guess that means we should take another look at the sheet music.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We might find more spots like this, so for now, let's just focus on playing it all the way through.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... Finally, our first full playthrough.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, we literally finished putting this song together yesterday, so I think we did pretty well since we sort of just dove straight into the deep end.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really? You think we'll be ready in time for the show?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Probably. This song should only need some minor adjustments, so all that's left is to practice playing it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's play it as much as possible and make it sound really amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But before we continue, why don't we take a quick water break? The truth is, I brought some snacks along today.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Snacks?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. They're cookies made with soy milk and soy pulp. I'm sure we all have some room for a quick bite, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, those look really good!
Thanks, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You made these on top of working on our schedule... Even though you didn't get home until pretty late yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm used to baking cookies, so this took no time at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I was able to work on our schedule while they baked, so I didn't actually have to stay up that late.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, also. I'll make sure to bring by some honeyed lemons and lemonade tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! Really?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's really nice of you, but are you sure? It sounds like a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know. We have to stick to a tight schedule if we want to be ready in time for our show...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which is why I want to support all of you during practice in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't do this every day, but you can look forward to me bringing snacks and such.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: H-Hona...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
You're a saint...! No, a goddess♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wah! Oh, Saki, you're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
No, she isn't.
Having the snacks you make always has this incredible calming effect.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you're showing genuine concern for our well-being, so thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means we should make sure to take good care of ourselves so Honami doesn't have to do all the work.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Especially if we want our song to reach Hanano and her brother's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right. We have to put on the best show we can!
After the show
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Isn't that...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They were both smiling...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Does that mean our song worked...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so!
No, I know so!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's hard to give a definite answer, but I sure hope so too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Thank goodness...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (The schedule I put together had some blind spots that ended up slowing us down a little...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I'm so glad I went through with all this!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, see you all tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami, wait!
We need to thank you again for all the stuff you made for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Getting through practice every day wasn't easy, but your goodies definitely became the reason why we could keep going!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She's right. It's normal to start losing motivation after practicing so much, but you prevented that from happening, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Exactly, so...
Thanks, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're all very welcome!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was worried that I'd look like too much of a busybody, but I'm so glad they enjoyed everything!)
